An announcement of Donald Trump's resignation/removal before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the announced resignation/removal goes into effect.

Only permanent removal from office will qualify.

markets.question: Will Venezuela recognize Israel by December 31?

markets.description:

markets.question: Will Tesla be the largest company in the world by market cap on December 31?
markets.eventTitle: Largest Company end of December 2026?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to the largest company in the world by market cap on December 31, 2026, as of market close.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.
